## About
CR Automotive was founded by Craig and Richard. When they retired, they passed the shop down to their most trusted technicians, now Jimmy, Darwin and the rest of the crew.
We're ASE certified technicians, a AAA Approved Repair Facility and a STAR Certified Smog Check Station. We work on all types of vehicles. If it fits through our door, we can fix it.
Our goal is simple: keep your family safe on the road. Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 149 Google reviews.

## Services
- Smog Check Inspection: Smog inspections done right here at the shop.
- Failed Smog Diagnostic and Repair: If your car didn't pass, we'll find out why and fix it.
- Complete Computer Diagnostics: We find the problem before we fix it.
- Wheel Alignment: Martin specializes in wheel alignments.
- Safety Inspection / Pre-Purchase Inspection: Have us look over a car before you buy it.
- Drive-ability diagnostic: Darwin specializes in drive-ability diagnostic work.
- Oil Changes & Service Maintenance: Oil changes and the regular maintenance your car needs.

## FAQ
Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. You can tow in or drop off before or after business hours. Key drops are by the main office door.

Q: My car failed its smog check. Can you help?
A: Yes. We test and repair all failed smog vehicles, and we're CAP approved.

Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: No. Our team doesn't install auto parts bought outside our shop.

Q: Do you take checks or payment plans?
A: No, we don't accept checks or payment plans.

Q: Is there a storage fee?
A: Yes. Storage is $90.00 per day, so plan to pick up your car promptly.
